philosophy.title: How We Tell Your Wedding Story
philosophy.quote: “We don't make you freeze for awkward poses or stop your rituals. We watch quietly, respect your elders, and capture the real emotion of your day.”
philosophy.author: Deepak • Lead Photographer & Founder
philosophy.lead: Your wedding day goes by in a flash. You shouldn't spend it squinting into harsh studio lights or waiting for a photographer to position your hands. We believe in candid, honest storytelling that captures how your wedding actually felt.
philosophy.pillar1Desc: Our 3-member team blends in quietly with your family and guests. We respect your family elders, pandits, and sacred rituals, never getting in the way of holy moments.
philosophy.pillar2Desc: We love warm, true-to-life colors inspired by classic 35mm film photography. No over-filtered skin or washed-out faces. Our videos are shot in sharp 4K with clear family audio.
philosophy.pillar3Title: Handcrafted Albums Delivered to Your Door
philosophy.pillar3Desc: Digital photos can easily be forgotten on a phone. We design luxury flushmount wedding albums printed on 50-year archival paper, packed in a wooden vault and delivered to your home.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.lead: Here are straightforward answers to the questions couples and parents ask us most often.
faq.q1: How much does wedding photography cost in Cuttack and Bhubaneswar?
faq.a1: Our packages start at ₹50,000 for bride-side coverage, ₹70,000 for groom-side coverage, and ₹1,10,000 for complete coverage of both families combined. Pre-wedding shoots start at ₹25,000. All packages include high-resolution edited photos and 4K cinematic video by our dedicated 3-artist Cuttack crew.
faq.q2: Do you travel to other districts across Odisha?
faq.a2: Yes, absolutely! While our home base is Cuttack, we regularly travel across all 30 districts of Odisha including Bhubaneswar, Puri, Jajpur, Angul, Balasore, Sambalpur, and Rourkela. Travel and stay are arranged transparently at actual costs.
faq.q3: How many photographers and videographers will be at our wedding?
faq.a3: Our core team consists of 3 seasoned artists: 1 candid photographer capturing raw emotions, 1 traditional photographer for stage family portraits, and 1 cinematographer filming in 4K. For large joint weddings, we scale up to 4 to 6 artists to cover both bride and groom rituals simultaneously.
faq.q4: When will we get our photos, video trailer, and printed album?
faq.a4: You will receive a curated sneak-peek of 25–30 edited photos within 7 days of the wedding. Your complete high-resolution online gallery and 4K video trailer are delivered in 3 to 4 weeks. Once you approve the photo selection, your custom printed flushmount album is hand-bound and delivered to your doorstep within 6 to 8 weeks.
faq.q5: Can we customize our package with extra days, drone, or parent albums?
faq.a5: Yes. You can add extra ceremony coverage (like engagement, reception, or Haldi), aerial 4K drone cinematography, vintage 35mm analog film rolls, or extra mini-albums for parents at clear, affordable add-on rates.

seo.title: Candid Odia Wedding Photography & 4K Cinema • Cuttack & Bhubaneswar
seo.col1Text: Deepak Photo Films is an independent wedding photography and 4K cinema collective based in Cuttack, Odisha. We specialize in unscripted, photojournalistic wedding coverage that honors sacred Odia traditions—from dawn Mangala Krutya and Vedic Mandap rituals to joyous Baraat processions and heartfelt Bidai moments. No artificial poses, just honest emotions and timeless memories.
seo.col2Text: Our collections include candid photography, 4K cinematic wedding highlight trailers, pre-wedding couple journeys, and vintage 35mm analog film rolls. Every celebration is complemented by color-graded digital galleries and bespoke flushmount heirloom albums printed on archival paper, encased in luxury wooden vaults and delivered to your doorstep.
seo.col3Text: Rooted in Cuttack and regularly shooting across Bhubaneswar, Puri, and Cuttack twin-city venues, our 3-artist crew travels across all 30 districts of Odisha including Angul, Jajpur, Balasore, Bhadrak, Sambalpur, and Rourkela, as well as destination weddings across India with transparent travel arrangements.
